title: Aeneas and the founding of Rome (Virgil)
subtitle: The Aeneid
subject: mythologie
description: In the Aeneid, Virgil tells how Aeneas, a prince who escaped from Troy, crossed the Mediterranean to found the line of Rome.

hero.hook: A fleeing Trojan carries his father on his shoulders: Rome is born from this exile.

blocks.text: The **Aeneid** is the great poem by **Virgil**. It tells the odyssey of **Aeneas**, Trojan prince who survived the fall of Troy. Guided by the gods, he crossed the Mediterranean to found, in Italy, the lineage that would lead to Rome.
It's not just an adventure. It is the myth of the birth of Roman power, written to give Rome a past worthy of Homer.

At the end of the 1st century BC, after civil wars, the emperor **August** wanted to stabilize his power. He commissions Virgil to write an epic worthy of Homer. The work also serves : linking the prince to a divine hero. [[Augustan propaganda]]

blocks.caption: Virgil, poet of the Aeneid, champion of a Rome willed by destiny.

blocks.text: Virgil worked there for eleven years (29-19 BC). The first six songs follow the wandering at sea. The next six tell of the war in Italy. He writes in , the verse of the great ancient epics. [[Dactylic hexameters]]
Virgil died in **19** BC and asked that the manuscript be burned, considered unfinished. Augustus forbids obeying. The national epic of Rome appears against the will of its author.

sections.title: Flight from Troy and love in Carthage

blocks.text: As Troy burns, at the end of the , Aeneas, son of the goddess **Venus** and the mortal Anchises, is ordered to flee. He leaves, carrying his father on his shoulders, his son Ascanius in his hand, and takes with him the , gods of the hearth. This gesture defines : duty to family, gods and destiny. [[Trojan War]] [[Penates]] [[Roman pietas]]

blocks.caption: Aeneas flees burning Troy, father and son with him.

blocks.text: In Carthage, he loves the queen **Dido**. But , king of the Roman gods, calls him back to his mission. Aeneas leaves. Dido commits suicide and curses her lineage: the myth thus explains the future hatred between Rome and Carthage, before the . [[Jupiter]] [[Punic Wars]]
Aeneas' son, Ascanius, is also called Iule. The  family, including Julius Caesar and Augustus, claims this divine origin via Venus. [[Julii]]

After a descent into Hell, Aeneas arrives in **Lazio**, in central Italy. King **Latinus** promises him his daughter **Lavinia**. But prince **Turnus**, supported by , a goddess hostile to the Trojans, starts the war. [[Juno]]
Aeneas defeats Turnus and founds **Lavinium**. Later, his son would found , from which Romulus and Remus would be born. The myth thus links Troy to Rome in a single chain. [[Alba the Long]]

blocks.text: In the Middle Ages, Virgil became an almost prophetic sage. Dante makes him his guide in the . But Aeneas is not a happy hero: he carries the weight of destiny. Rome was born from exile, from sacrificed love and from war. [[The Divine Comedy]]
In the **Aeneid**, Virgil makes **Aeneas**, a survivor of Troy, the mythical ancestor of Rome. The hero embodies **pietas**: duty before desire, destiny before personal happiness.
